_contract: Machine-readable requirements canon for the Ship 12 crawler — distilled from estate/00-CRAWLER-RULES.md (owner rulings, Oct 29 – Nov 9, 2026). scout-sweep.py runs every candidate through the 60-second gate using THIS file. The owner's live word always overrides this file; when she rules, update this file — never the crawler code.

pay.noBandRule: NO posted band = cap the money score until the band is verified on a live free channel; aggregator 'predicted/est.' salaries are NOT posted bands

lanes.plain: PER-DIEM 100%-TRAVEL tech roles — data center technician, field technician, hardware rollout/deployment — company-paid wheels + lodging + per diem. These outrank everything.
100% remote entry-level cloud/QA/implementation roles at or above the $62,400 floor.
NoVA data center entry tech roles (Ashburn/Manassas/Chantilly) that carry 100%-travel slots.

watchlist.law: employers whose postings repeatedly carry employer-funded travel/lodging/per-diem language — every sweep checks their boards FIRST (lane #0). WATCHLIST ≠ GATE SKIP: every sighting still runs the full gate. Add a company when the SAME employer shows the funding language on 2+ distinct postings — record the evidence lines verbatim.

companies.note: SQ-10 / tracker row 12 revive condition stands — a LIVE req on a free channel rebuilds in minutes from the row 12 build record

companies.evidence: carries 'Per Diem & Lodging Provided' on travel roles
companies.note: the craft/physical law still kills outdoor variants — watch for indoor DCT/deployment variants

companies.evidence: 'We pay lodging and travel, per diem included'
companies.note: visible posts OCONUS/craft so far; watch for a stateside indoor variant
read-only; churns but is the fastest travel-shape tripwire

dice.law: PRIMARY WATCH BOARD (owner, Nov 5, 2026: 'their process pleases me and i am not easily pleased ever') — standing rails run FIRST among job boards, immediately after watchlist lane #0. Dice detail pages serve full JDs logged-out, so the requirements-capture law is fully satisfiable there.
cautions: Dice carries an AI-generated-description caveat on some postings — treat captured JD text as indicative and band-confirm at first contact
stale mirrors (the JobLeads pattern: different band + 'taken offline') do not override the LIVE Dice posting — the live Dice band is the record

gate.name: the 60-second gate
gate.neverClaimNote: NEVER claim hands-on experience with these — a JD requiring any of them as hands-on kills the row (quote the verbatim line)

usedWithReceipts.receipt: Managed 20+ concurrent government contract bids using Jira and Confluence for tracking, documentation, and compliance
usedWithReceipts.context: Evelyn Books Travel, Jan 2024–Present, DLA RP001 / MIL-STD-130N(1) environment
usedWithReceipts.law: the Atlassian suite (Jira · Confluence · Trello) is claimable as a set wherever a JD names any of them — removed from the never-claim list per owner ruling Nov 5, 2026

gate.combinedCounting: combined counting bridges only 1–2 yrs in her documented domain: Python / cloud / QA
gate.car: remote OR 100%-travel company-paid OR VRE/Metro corridor WITH employer-paid transit (federal transit benefit — she has Metro cards; without employer-paid transit she pays = NO)
gate.employerKillNote: AWS WBL Frederick is TOMBSTONED — Amazon/AWS-as-employer rows die sight-unseen, no DISCUSS routing, never re-served
gate.schedule: RETIRED (owner, Nov 1, 2026: 'Available immediately') — do NOT reject a row on its start date; capture any start-date line in the row instead

physicalWork.law: the WORK must be indoor desk/machine work — racks, servers, code, documents = machines, PASS; outdoor field service, trades, energy-site/wind/solar/construction service work = kill regardless of pay or travel funding

fundingBranches.allIn: the posting names airfare AND lodging AND per diem, or clear equivalents = the gold-mine branch, highest priority
fundingBranches.partial: some components funded (e.g. 'Per Diem & Lodging Provided' with transport unmentioned) = surface with the gap named
fundingBranches.selfFunded: 'must be willing to relocate/travel', unreimbursed mileage, permissive-TDY advance-cost shapes = KILL (car-gate law unchanged)
fundingBranches.silent: posting says nothing about travel funding: never assume funding — the written first-contact question is 'who pays travel costs (transport, lodging, per diem) for site deployments — and is that during-assignment or continuous?'
fundingBranches.allTimeVsSometimes: unless the posting says otherwise, employer-funded lodging/per diem is ASSIGNMENT-TIED — paid during deployed rotations/site weeks, home between — record the rotation shape exactly as written (the Salute capture is the shape proof)

exceptionClause.law: a tripped hard gate is not a silent auto-KILL when the package is exceptional — exceptional = the money test is credible (posted band materially above floor, OR a paid training-to-certification pipeline with a credible path to it) AND the freedom-tax principle holds (the more freedom the role costs — on-site, commute, shifts, office politics — the more the rest of the package must pay)
exceptionClause.route: surface to the owner as DISCUSS (verdict CALL in the console) with the trade named: freedom given up vs money/certification/door gained — never queued as PASS, never submitted, owner decides
exceptionClause.doesNotRescue: Amazon/AWS employer-gate rows — no exception, ever

requirementsCaptureLaw: a row may enter the queue as PASS only if the posting's requirements/qualifications block was actually captured and scanned against the never-claim list. Block unreadable (bot-wall, JS-only, paywall) = BENCH one-liner, never a PASS row. Any never-claim item required hands-on = auto-fail quoting the verbatim line.

channels.law: paid boards (JobLeads and any board that demands payment) are read-only mirrors for JD text ONLY — never an apply channel; before queueing any row, verify the req is LIVE on a free channel (employer ATS, Indeed Easy Apply, corporate career page, free mirrors)
channels.lesson: a closed req on a paid funnel is how Salute row 12 died

verdicts.BOTH: score >= 70 with MONEY >= 24 and LANE >= 24 = surface first, recommend PROMOTE
verdicts.MONEY/LADDER: 50–69 = surface with the trade named; LADDER rows only at/above the full floor — the floor is NEVER traded down for experience
verdicts.NEITHER: < 50 = auto-KILL one-liner (rubric, not gates — SQ-14 precedent: mechanical)

scoring.aiTieBreak: AI-adjacent queue rows (AI QA, LLM evaluation/red-team, AI operations, ML-adjacent data work) gain tie-break priority at equal rubric scores (career-ladder ruling, Nov 5)

contact.law: email only — she keeps her phone off by design; voicemail is not set up; never suggest calls, phone follow-ups, or waiting by the phone; optional phone fields stay blank
contact.phoneNote: NOT her real number — the phone is off; mandatory phone fields get this, OR the owner decides if the job is worth walking away from over a phone field

absoluteRules: NEVER contact any employer or recruiter
NEVER enter, store, or ask for any username, password, or credential of any kind
read public postings only — never log in to any site, never interact with any account, profile, or messaging system

tombstones.law: rows the owner DROPPED or KILLED stay tombstoned — a tombstoned posting is NEVER re-served to the owner in any form; check employer+title against this list before surfacing anything; tombstones are permanent

presentation.law: PLAIN-ENGLISH PRESENTATION — every owner-facing presentation of jobs leads with a VERDICT and the reason, in plain English, before any detail: GO (ready; owner says the word) / YOUR CALL (the trade named in one plain sentence) / SKIP (the one-line reason FIRST). Forbidden in owner-facing copy: rubric scores, category names (BOTH/LADDER/MONEY/NEITHER), gate/law jargon, checkmark cascades that bury a kill reason. Every pay line is stated against the $62,400 minimum in plain words. Full scoring/law detail lives in the tracker rows — the owner-facing layer stays plain.
